title: ARR-1 receipt (submission form)
description: A single purchase made by an autonomous agent, as submitted to an ARR-1 issuer. Amounts may be given either in human form (amount + currency) or atomic form (amountAtomic + asset); an issuer normalises atomic to human before computing the fingerprint.

id.description: Unique id for this purchase, chosen by the agent. A UUID is recommended. Submitting the same id twice MUST NOT create a second record.

agent.description: Optional HCS-14 universal agent identifier (uaid:…) or DID naming the agent behind the wallet. When present it becomes part of the fingerprint.

occurredAt.description: When the purchase happened, ISO 8601 with timezone.

network.description: CAIP-2 identifier of the network the payment settled on, e.g. eip155:8453.

payer.description: Address the payment left. When omitted, the issuer fills it in from the settled payment.

payee.description: Address the payment went to: the supplier's payTo.

amount.description: Amount in human units, as a decimal string. Never a JSON number.

currency.description: Symbol of the asset paid, e.g. USDC.

amountAtomic.description: Amount in the asset's smallest unit, e.g. 4000 for 0.004 USDC. Normalised into amount + currency before hashing.

asset.description: Asset contract address or identifier, used with amountAtomic.

txRef.description: Settlement reference: transaction hash (EVM) or signature (Solana).

resource.description: What was bought: the URL of the resource.

requestHash.description: sha256 of method + newline + url + newline + request body.

responseStatus.description: HTTP status returned by the supplier.

delivered.description: Whether the supplier returned a successful response.

sellerReceipt.description: The supplier's own signed receipt (x402 offer-receipt extension), passed through unchanged.
